description: A close English retelling of the folktale in which poor Per inherits only a cat, who cunningly wins him royal favor with ever-grander gifts, outwits a sun-fearing troll, and finally reveals herself as an enchanted princess.
tone: Classic folktale, witty, magical, and triumphant
summary: A poor boy and his clever cat win a kingdom by gifts, bold bluffing, and a troll’s downfall at sunrise.
